records.completeness_basis: The 2026-2027 catalog "Degrees and Programs" page lists 34 EOU bachelor's programs under "Undergraduate Majors" and "Bachelors of Applied Science" (the 3+2 Political Science to MPA path and the OSU and OHSU cooperative programs, whose degrees other universities confer, are not counted). 31 have verified records; Anthropology/Sociology, Biology and Health and Human Performance are listed but not yet recorded.
